Figure 1: Overview of our proposed PARL framework for inducing personalized user rubrics for evaluating LLM personalization. PARL consists of two core modules: (1) Preference Induction & Consistency Validation; (2) Discriminative Optimization via RL. The final induced rubrics serve as high-fidelity evaluation metrics for personalized text generation.
